_comment: Copy to redaction_rules.json (or set REDACTION_RULES_FILE). Each rule masks matching text as [REDACTED:<NAME>] for any user BELOW min_clearance. Omit min_clearance (or use null) to mask for everyone. allow_users is a need-to-know list that bypasses the clearance test. Give exactly one of 'regex' or 'terms'. Built-in rules SSN and CARD are masked for everyone unless you define a rule with the same name. A malformed file makes queries FAIL rather than answer unredacted.
